description: Hourly forecast for one coordinate from MET Norway. The data is under CC BY 4.0 and the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data. wttr.in is not proxied: its software license does not grant the forecast data. Does not spend points and does not accept a URL. If you supply fields, the hub returns privacy_consent_required until the controller has accepted the current privacy version. Do not invent that acceptance.
name: hub_weather-point
